Finally the game began with the whistle blown by the referee.

questions.passage: We took the floor for warm-ups and we were all flying high. The Knights were already warming up and __________. During the national anthem I felt like I was going to throw up. I could feel my heart pounding in my chest. I was at this point more than a little worried about this game. Would we be able to match them on their home court? Was Tony going to keep his cool? Was I going to play well? So many questions. So many things to worry about. I tried to take some advice Coach Doug had given me once: when it comes time to play the game, leave all your problems off the court and play ball. Finally the game began with the whistle blown by the referee.
questions.stem:

The Knights were already warming up and __________.
(그들은 꽤 자신 있어 보였다.)
